instruction: How to set up Crossplane with a custom provider
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-my-custom
spec:
  package: myregistry.io/provider-my-custom:v0.1.0
  controllerConfigRef:
    name: custom-config'

instruction: How to build a Crossplane provider locally
output: git clone https://github.com/crossplane-contrib/provider-aws.git && cd provider-aws && make build

instruction: How to push a Crossplane provider package
output: crossplane xpkg build --name my-provider --package-root=. --output=my-provider.xpkg && crossplane xpkg push myregistry.io/provider-my-custom:v0.1.0 -f my-provider.xpkg
